d: Short, wavy auburn hair is styled with thick bangs and a single braid falling over the shoulder. The large, expressive eyes are a vivid crimson, set into a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build is dressed in a blue and white nautical-themed dress featuring a wide flared skirt decorated with musical note motifs, paired with white stockings and blue pointed heels. A small white sailor's hat sits atop the head, and the character stands beside a large, ornate olive-green hybrid harp-bass instrument.
